title: strobilanthes timorensis var. quadriovulatus
intro: Strobilanthes timorensis var. quadriovulatus, commonly known as the Quadro-Leafed Strobilanthes, is a plant species belonging to the family Acanthaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential health benefits in reducing inflammation and as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Strobilanthes timorensis var. quadriovulatus include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
